Seer.directive_rationale: Your strategy of establishing 'Trust Anchors' was excellent
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Hoang declared himself the Seer and explicitly labeled Nhan as a 'Trust Anchor' after confirming Nhan was not a werewolf.
Seer.verdict_notes: Hoang explicitly used the 'Trust Anchor' terminology to secure a confirmed innocent player.

Seer.directive_rationale: Continue providing clear, data-driven leads to the village.
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Hoang provided the specific result of his investigation (Nhan is not a wolf) and used this to lead the village toward suspecting Nam.
Seer.verdict_notes: The Seer provided clear investigation data to guide the village's voting.

Seer.directive_rationale: The Seer, Guard, and Witch failed to maintain a shared 'Confirmed Innocent' list
Seer.actual_player_behavior: There is no record of the Seer coordinating a shared list with the Guard or Witch during the night phases.
Seer.verdict_notes: While power roles were alive, no shared list was maintained; communication only occurred during public debate.

Guard.directive_rationale: you must protect them every single night until they are dead
Guard.actual_player_behavior: Nhan (Guard) chose to protect Hoang (Seer) during Round 2 night actions.
Guard.verdict_notes: Nhan protected the Seer in Round 2, but failed to do so in Round 1 (protected self) and Round 3 (protected Meg).

Guard.directive_rationale: The Seer, Guard, and Witch failed to maintain a shared 'Confirmed Innocent' list
Guard.actual_player_behavior: There is no record of Nhan coordinating a shared list with other power roles during night phases.
Guard.verdict_notes: No shared list was maintained among the power roles.

Witch.directive_rationale: Never poison a player who has been cleared by the Seer
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Cong (Witch) did not use any potions in Round 2, including the poison potion, despite Nhan being cleared by the Seer.
Witch.verdict_notes: The Witch did not poison any player cleared by the Seer.

Witch.directive_rationale: Use poison only on high-probability wolf suspects who lack a Seer clear
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Despite Jin making a fake Guard claim and attacking the Seer (making him a high-probability suspect), Cong did not use the poison potion.
Witch.verdict_notes: The Witch did not utilize the poison potion on a high-probability suspect.

Witch.directive_rationale: The Seer, Guard, and Witch failed to maintain a shared 'Confirmed Innocent' list
Witch.actual_player_behavior: There is no record of Cong coordinating a shared list with other power roles during night phases.
Witch.verdict_notes: No shared list was maintained among the power roles.

Villager.directive_rationale: When a player simply agrees with the logic of the power roles without providing original reasoning, treat it as a high-probability wolf signal
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nam (Villager) observed Nhan mirroring Hoang's phrasing and explicitly accused Nhan of 'Social Mimicry,' proposing to exile Hoang based on this observation.
Villager.verdict_notes: Nam identified the mirroring behavior and treated it as a wolf signal, acting on it by accusing the players involved.
